# GLM-5.3-Flash-Abliterated-LoRA-GGUF

Unofficial community derivative of [zai-org/GLM-5.3-Flash](https://huggingface.co/zai-org/GLM-5.3-Flash), published by GCSA-AiLab.

这是 GCSA-AiLab 发布的 [zai-org/GLM-5.3-Flash](https://huggingface.co/zai-org/GLM-5.3-Flash) 非官方社区衍生版本。

LoRA adapters only; a compatible base model is required separately. V1 and V2 differ in the distribution of edited layers. Select a version after testing it against your evaluation goals.

仅包含 LoRA 适配器，须另备兼容的基础模型。V1 与 V2 的差异在于修改层的分布，请按评测目标验证后选择。
